title: HB827 (2017 Regular): Public Safety - Secretary of State Police - Temporary Firearms Training Waiver

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2017RS/bills/hb/hb0827f.pdf)
provenance.note: first reader: bill as filed; no enrolled text read; no passage vote recorded.

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-306(b)(2)): (2) (I) THE SECRETARY MAY TEMPORARILY WAIVE THE REQUIREMENT TO COMPLETE A CERTIFIED FIREARMS TRAINING COURSE UNDER SUBSECTION (A) OF THIS SECTION ON A DETERMINATION THAT THE APPLICANT HAS: 1. OBTAINED A PROTECTIVE ORDER; 2. OBTAINED A PEACE ORDER; 3. DEMONSTRATED CLEAR EVIDENCE THAT THE APPLICANT HAS BEEN THE VICTIM OF SERIOUS DOMESTIC ABUSE; OR 4. DEMONSTRATED CLEAR EVIDENCE OF IMMINENT DANGER TO THE APPLICANT. (II) AN APPLICANT ISSUED A PERMIT UNDER THIS PARAGRAPH SHALL COMPLETE THE TRAINING COURSE WITHIN 60 DAYS AFTER THE ISSUANCE OF THE PERMIT.
